"""Independently executed final Goal 18 actual Blender review, without saving scene."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import json
import hashlib
import math
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts' / 'blender'))
from materials_checks import inspect, exercise, mesh_geometry, full_material, digest, shape_hashes
from materials_geometry import EYES, CHANGED, REMOVED, ROLES
from feathers_geometry import set_gesture
from feathers_checks import inventory
from primary_geometry import source_tree

out = Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1])
before_bytes = Path(bpy.data.filepath).read_bytes()
baseline = json.loads((ROOT/'tmp/goal18-technical/baseline-snapshot.json').read_bytes())
own = json.loads((out.parent/'snapshot.json').read_bytes())
assert shape_hashes() == own['mesh_geometry_sha256'], 'Production geometry digest diverges from independent algorithm'
checks = inspect(ROOT)
checks['movement'] = exercise(ROOT)
unchanged = {n: h for n, h in baseline['mesh_geometry_sha256'].items() if n not in set(CHANGED)|set(REMOVED)}
assert len(unchanged) == 78 and all(checks['shape_sha256'][n] == h for n,h in unchanged.items())
assert baseline['eyes'] == own['eyes'], 'Independent complete eye object/mesh state differs'
eye_materials = set(m for eye in baseline['eyes'].values() for m in eye['material_slots'])
assert all(own['materials'][m] == baseline['materials'][m] for m in eye_materials)
assert baseline['nonmesh'] == own['nonmesh'], 'Actual studio or original pivots differ'
extra = {'additional_gesture_states': [], 'neutral_feather_foot_tech_collision_checks': 0,
         'geometry_digest_algorithms_identical': True, 'exact_retained_meshes': len(unchanged),
         'exact_eight_eye_components': True, 'exact_assigned_eye_materials': sorted(eye_materials),
         'exact_original_pivots_cameras_lights': True, 'uv_maps': {}}
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type != 'MESH' or obj.name in EYES:
        continue
    assert all(mat is not None and mat.name.startswith('MAT_') for mat in obj.data.materials)
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        assert p.material_index < len(obj.data.materials)
    for mat in obj.data.materials:
        surface = mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Surface')
        output = mat.node_tree.nodes.get('SurfaceOutput')
        assert surface and output and output.inputs['Surface'].is_linked
        assert not surface.mute and not output.mute and output.is_active_output
    if any(m.name.startswith('MAT_Feather') for m in obj.data.materials):
        uv = obj.data.uv_layers.get('ldv_feather')
        assert uv and len(uv.data) == len(obj.data.loops), (obj.name, 'missing actual authored UV map')
        points = [tuple(p.uv) for p in uv.data]
        assert all(math.isfinite(v) and -1e-7 <= v <= 1+1e-7 for p in points for v in p)
        assert max(p[1] for p in points)-min(p[1] for p in points) > .99
        extra['uv_maps'][obj.name] = {'loops': len(points), 'minimum_u': min(p[0] for p in points),
            'maximum_u': max(p[0] for p in points), 'minimum_v': min(p[1] for p in points), 'maximum_v': max(p[1] for p in points)}
foot_tech = {o.name: source_tree(o)[0] for o in bpy.context.scene.objects
             if o.type=='MESH' and (o.name.startswith('GRP_') or o.name.startswith('TECH_'))}
for name in sorted(inventory()):
    tree = source_tree(bpy.data.objects[name])[0]
    for target, t in foot_tech.items():
        assert not tree.overlap(t), (name,target,'neutral feather/foot/tech intersection')
        extra['neutral_feather_foot_tech_collision_checks'] += 1
neutral = shape_hashes()
try:
    for left,right in ((.25,0), (0,.25), (.25,.75), (.75,.25), (.75,.75)):
        set_gesture(ROOT,left,right)
        count = 0
        for name in sorted(inventory()):
            if not name.startswith('FTH_Wing'):
                continue
            tree = source_tree(bpy.data.objects[name])[0]
            for target,t in foot_tech.items():
                assert not tree.overlap(t),(left,right,name,target,'additional gesture collision')
                count += 1
        extra['additional_gesture_states'].append({'left':left,'right':right,'collision_checks':count})
finally:
    set_gesture(ROOT,0,0)
assert neutral == shape_hashes()
assert before_bytes == Path(bpy.data.filepath).read_bytes(), 'Read-only review altered scene bytes'
result = {'reviewer': 'goal18_technical_review', 'blender_version': bpy.app.version_string,
          'scene_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before_bytes).hexdigest(), 'scene_size_bytes': len(before_bytes),
          'actual_checks': checks, 'independent_checks': extra, 'scene_bytes_unchanged': True}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('INDEPENDENT FINAL TECHNICAL BLENDER REVIEW PASS:', result['scene_sha256'])

"""Compare protected historical and accepted #6 sources to actual baseline Git/LFS bytes."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import json
import hashlib
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
from feathers_contracts import PROTECTED_SHA256, SOURCES
if '--materials' in sys.argv:
    from materials_contracts import PROTECTED_SHA256

BASELINE = "a8634936494512d64e311149f20ed4e24ea492ac"
output = Path(sys.argv[1])
git = lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT)
sha = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
tracked_reviews = git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BASELINE,
                      "validation/reviews/feathers_v01").decode().splitlines()
inventory = sorted(set(PROTECTED_SHA256) | set(SOURCES) | set(tracked_reviews) |
                   {"blender/scene/owli_feathers_v01.blend"})
result = {"baseline_commit": BASELINE, "protected_contract_count": len(PROTECTED_SHA256),
          "source_59_count": len(SOURCES), "accepted_goal6_review_count": len(tracked_reviews),
          "files": {}, "failures": []}
for name in inventory:
    raw = git("show", BASELINE + ":" + name)
    actual = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    if raw.startswith(b"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\n"):
        lines = raw.decode().splitlines()
        expected = next(line.split(":")[1] for line in lines if line.startswith("oid sha256:"))
        size = int(next(line.split()[1] for line in lines if line.startswith("size ")))
        record = {"lfs_oid": expected, "expected_size_bytes": size,
                  "unchanged": sha(actual) == expected and len(actual) == size}
    else:
        record = {"git_blob_sha256": sha(raw), "unchanged": actual == raw}
    record["actual_sha256"] = sha(actual)
    record["actual_size_bytes"] = len(actual)
    if name in PROTECTED_SHA256:
        record["protected_contract_matches"] = record.get("lfs_oid", record.get("git_blob_sha256")) == PROTECTED_SHA256[name]
    result["files"][name] = record
    if not record["unchanged"] or record.get("protected_contract_matches", True) is False:
        result["failures"].append(name)
result["file_count"] = len(inventory)
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print("INDEPENDENT ACTUAL GIT/LFS AUDIT:", len(inventory), "files;", len(result["failures"]), "failures")
assert not result["failures"], result["failures"]

"""Independent recursive schema and semantic adversarial audit on actual worker data."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import copy
import sys
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

from materials_gate import worker_shape,validate_shape,validate_worker_semantics,load_json

cfg=load_json(ROOT/'design/materials_lookdev.json')
baseline=load_json(ROOT/'validation/reviews/feathers_v01/reload_b_checks.json')
data=load_json(ROOT/'tmp/goal18/run02/build_checks.json')
shape=worker_shape(cfg,baseline,True)
result={'worker_path':'tmp/goal18/run02/build_checks.json','structural_dict_omissions':0,
        'structural_sequence_truncations':0,'semantic_mutations':{},'accepted_semantic_mutations':[]}
assert not validate_worker_semantics(data,cfg,baseline,True)
def recurse(value,schema,path):
    if isinstance(schema,str):return
    if 'dict' in schema or 'keys' in schema:
        fields=schema['dict'] if 'dict' in schema else {key:schema['values'] for key in schema['keys']}
        for key,sub in fields.items():
            missing=dict(value);missing.pop(key)
            assert validate_shape(missing,schema,path),('accepted omission',path,key)
            result['structural_dict_omissions']+=1
            recurse(value[key],sub,path+'/'+key)
    else:
        if value:
            assert validate_shape(value[:-1],schema,path),('accepted sequence truncation',path)
            result['structural_sequence_truncations']+=1
        items=schema['items']
        for i,child in enumerate(value):
            recurse(child,items[0] if len(items)==1 else items[i],path+'/'+str(i))
recurse(data,shape,'worker')

def mutate(label,path,value):
    candidate=copy.deepcopy(data);target=candidate
    for key in path[:-1]:target=target[key]
    target[path[-1]]=value
    errors=validate_worker_semantics(candidate,cfg,baseline,True)
    result['semantic_mutations'][label]={'rejected':bool(errors),'errors':errors[:3]}
    if not errors:result['accepted_semantic_mutations'].append(label)
